startTalents.name: 위풍당당
startTalents.description:
돌진 공격이나 방어의 받아치기 등 추가 공격을 적에게 적중시키면 위풍당당 중첩이 하나 부여됩니다(최대 3).

startTalents.description_en:
Hitting an enemy with any additional ATTACK move, such as DASH attack or DEFENSE's Ripost, grants one Panache token (up to 3)
Each Panache token increases ATTACK damage by 20% and grants +{0}% ATTACK SPEED, all Panache tokens are lost when Romeo is hit

퀘스트 (x20): 특수 능력을 1명 이상의 적에게 적중시키면 치명타 확률이 +0.5 증가합니다.

startTalents.description_en:
Quest (x20): Hitting at least one enemy with SPECIAL grants +0.5 Crit Chance
Complete: Any enemy hit by SPECIAL has a {0}% chance to grant Romeo 2 Dream Shard(s)

startTalents.name: 비밀 무기
